sections.heading: FIELDS
sections.content:
ProBuilderMesh is the core MonoBehaviour component that stores all geometry and attribute data for editable meshes. Below is the complete enumeration of every constant, serialized field, non-serialized field, and internal property:

1. Constants:
- `k_MeshFilterHideFlags` (`HideFlags`): Set to `HideFlags.DontSave | HideFlags.HideInInspector | HideFlags.NotEditable` (when `ENABLE_DRIVEN_PROPERTIES` is defined) or `HideFlags.HideInInspector | HideFlags.NotEditable`. Conceals the internal backing `MeshFilter` component from the inspector.
- `k_HelpUrl` (`string`): Value `"https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.probuilder@latest"`.
- `k_IconPath` (`string`): Value `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditableMesh.png"`.
- `k_UVChannelCount` (`int`): Value `4`. Maximum UV channels supported by the data model.
- `k_MeshFormatVersion` (`int`): Current mesh format version, value `2` (`k_MeshFormatVersionAutoUVScaleOffset`).
- `k_MeshFormatVersionSubmeshMaterialRefactor` (`int`): Value `1`.
- `k_MeshFormatVersionAutoUVScaleOffset` (`int`): Value `2`.
- `maxVertexCount` (`uint`): Maximum addressable vertex count per mesh, value `ushort.MaxValue` (65535).
- `k_UnitializedVersionIndex` (`ushort`): Value `0`.

2. Serialized Fields (Backing Mesh Data):
- `m_MeshFormatVersion` (`int`): Serialized version number for upgrading legacy data formats during `ToMesh()`.
- `m_Faces` (`Face[]`): Serialized array of `Face` objects representing polygons, triangle indices, submesh indices, and unwrapping settings (formerly serialized as `_quads`).
- `m_SharedVertices` (`SharedVertex[]`): Serialized array of `SharedVertex` objects grouping coincident spatial vertex indices (formerly serialized as `_sharedIndices`, `m_SharedVertexes`).
- `m_SharedTextures` (`SharedVertex[]`): Serialized array of `SharedVertex` objects grouping coincident UV0 texture coordinates (formerly serialized as `_sharedIndicesUV`).
- `m_Positions` (`Vector3[]`): Serialized array of local vertex positions (formerly serialized as `_vertices`).
- `m_Textures0` (`Vector2[]`): Serialized array of UV channel 0 texture coordinates (formerly serialized as `_uv`).
- `m_Textures2` (`List<Vector4>`): Serialized list of UV channel 2 texture coordinates (formerly serialized as `_uv3`).
- `m_Textures3` (`List<Vector4>`): Serialized list of UV channel 3 texture coordinates (formerly serialized as `_uv4`).
- `m_Tangents` (`Vector4[]`): Serialized array of explicit or generated vertex tangents (formerly serialized as `_tangents`).
- `m_Colors` (`Color[]`): Serialized array of per-vertex RGBA colors (formerly serialized as `_colors`).
- `m_UnwrapParameters` (`UnwrapParameters`): Lightmap UV2 generation settings struct containing `hardAngle`, `packMargin`, `angleError`, and `areaError` (formerly serialized as `unwrapParameters`).
- `m_PreserveMeshAssetOnDestroy` (`bool`): Determines if the underlying `UnityEngine.Mesh` asset is kept on disk when the component is destroyed (formerly serialized as `dontDestroyMeshOnDelete`).
- `assetGuid` (`string`): GUID identifier used when the 'Meshes are Assets' workflow is enabled.
- `m_Mesh` (`Mesh`): Direct reference to the compiled `UnityEngine.Mesh` instance.
- `m_VersionIndex` (`ushort`, default `0`): Monotonically incrementing counter used to track modifications and detect synchronization state with the compiled mesh.
- `m_IsSelectable` (`bool`, default `true`): Controls whether elements on this mesh can be selected in editor tools.
- `m_SelectedFaces` (`int[]`, default empty array): Serialized array of selected face indices pointing into `m_Faces`.
- `m_SelectedEdges` (`Edge[]`, default empty array): Serialized array of selected `Edge` structs.
- `m_SelectedVertices` (`int[]`, default empty array): Serialized array of selected vertex indices pointing into `m_Positions`.

3. Non-Serialized & Runtime State Fields:
- `m_CacheValid` (`CacheValidState` enum bitfield: `SharedVertex = 1 << 0`, `SharedTexture = 1 << 1`): Tracks validity of lookup caches.
- `m_SharedVertexLookup` (`Dictionary<int, int>`): Maps vertex index `i` to its corresponding group index in `m_SharedVertices`.
- `m_SharedTextureLookup` (`Dictionary<int, int>`): Maps vertex index `i` to its corresponding group index in `m_SharedTextures`.
- `m_Normals` (`Vector3[]`): Runtime cached normal vectors.
- `m_MeshRenderer` (`MeshRenderer`): Cached reference to sibling `MeshRenderer` component.
- `m_MeshFilter` (`MeshFilter`): Cached reference to sibling `MeshFilter` component.
- `m_InstanceVersionIndex` (`ushort`, default `0`): Runtime instance version counter used to detect duplication, instance creation, and session modification state.
- `m_SelectedCacheDirty` (`bool`): Dirty flag indicating cached selection counts and arrays need recalculation.
- `m_SelectedSharedVerticesCount` (`int`): Cached count of unique shared vertex groups in the current selection.
- `m_SelectedCoincidentVertexCount` (`int`): Cached total count of all coincident vertices across selected shared groups.
- `m_SelectedSharedVertices` (`HashSet<int>`): Cached set of shared vertex indices in the current selection.
- `m_SelectedCoincidentVertices` (`List<int>`): Cached list of all coincident vertex indices in the current selection.
- `s_CachedHashSet` (`static HashSet<int>`): Shared static hash set used to avoid allocations during UV projection and coincident vertex queries.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, a custom Resource or Node (e.g. ProBuilderMesh3D extending Node3D or MeshInstance3D) can store these arrays in PackedVector3Array, PackedColorArray, PackedVector2Array, and PackedInt32Array. Godot ArrayMesh uses SurfaceTool/MeshDataTool and surface arrays (Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX, Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL, Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV, Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2, Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR, Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT, Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX).

sections.heading: MESH REPRESENTATION
sections.content:
ProBuilderMesh uses a per-face unique-vertex topology model. In this representation, no two `Face` instances share identical vertex indices in `m_Positions`; every face owns its own discrete vertex indices. Coincident spatial positions and texture coordinates across faces are maintained through separate index grouping arrays:

1. Vertex Attribute Arrays:
- Positions are stored in `Vector3[] m_Positions`, where `m_Positions.Length == vertexCount`.
- Vertex colors are stored in `Color[] m_Colors`. If `m_Colors` is null, `GetColors()` returns an array filled with `Color.white`.
- Normals are stored in `Vector3[] m_Normals` (calculated on demand via `Normals.CalculateNormals(this)`).
- Tangents are stored in `Vector4[] m_Tangents` (calculated on demand via `Normals.CalculateTangents(this)`).
- Texture channels: Channel 0 is stored in `Vector2[] m_Textures0`; Channel 1 (lightmap UV) is stored directly on the `UnityEngine.Mesh.uv2` property; Channels 2 and 3 are stored in `List<Vector4> m_Textures2` and `List<Vector4> m_Textures3`.
- `HasArrays(MeshArrays channels)` tests for the presence of requested attribute arrays and verifies that each array's length matches `vertexCount`.

2. Faces and Polygons:
- Stored in `Face[] m_Faces`. Each `Face` encapsulates its triangulation (`int[] indexesInternal`, with length divisible by 3), material mapping (`int submeshIndex`), unwrapping parameters (`AutoUnwrapSettings uv`), smoothing group (`int smoothingGroup`), texture group (`int textureGroup`), and element group (`int elementGroup`).
- `faceCount` returns `m_Faces.Length`. `triangleCount` returns the sum of `face.indexesInternal.Length / 3`. `indexCount` returns the total count of vertex indices across all faces.
- `edgeCount` computes the sum of `face.edgesInternal.Length` across all faces.

3. Shared Vertices (Spatial Coincidence):
- `m_SharedVertices` (`SharedVertex[]`) defines groups of vertex indices that share identical 3D spatial positions. Each `SharedVertex` wraps an `int[]` of coincident vertex indices.
- `sharedVertexLookup` (`Dictionary<int, int>`) maps each vertex index `v` to its group index `k` in `m_SharedVertices`. When `(m_CacheValid & CacheValidState.SharedVertex) == 0`, `SharedVertex.GetSharedVertexLookup(m_SharedVertices, m_SharedVertexLookup)` rebuilds the lookup table and sets the cache flag.
- `GetCoincidentVertices()` retrieves all vertex indices coincident with a single vertex, a list of vertices, a set of edges, or a set of faces.

4. Shared Textures (UV0 Coincidence):
- `m_SharedTextures` (`SharedVertex[]`) defines groups of vertex indices that share continuous UV coordinates in channel 0.
- Cached via `sharedTextureLookup` (`Dictionary<int, int>`) and `CacheValidState.SharedTexture`.

5. Index Buffers & Formats:
- In `ToMesh()`, if `vertexCount > ushort.MaxValue` (65535), `mesh.indexFormat` is set to `Rendering.IndexFormat.UInt32`; otherwise it is set to `Rendering.IndexFormat.UInt16`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot 4's ArrayMesh uses separate surfaces for each material. The ProBuilder data model corresponds to an intermediate editable representation where faces keep per-vertex attributes unshared, and an exporter compiles surfaces into an ArrayMesh or ImporterMesh.

sections.heading: SUBMESH STRUCTURE
sections.content:
ProBuilderMesh organizes triangles and quads into submeshes corresponding to the materials assigned to the `MeshRenderer` component. The submesh mapping algorithm in `ToMesh()` proceeds through the following concrete steps:

1. Material Count Determination:
- `MaterialUtility.GetMaterialCount(renderer)` queries the `MeshRenderer.sharedMaterials` array length.
- `Submesh.GetSubmeshes(facesInternal, materialCount, preferredTopology)` is called to group faces by `face.submeshIndex` into `Submesh` objects containing `m_Indexes`, `m_Topology` (`MeshTopology.Triangles` or `MeshTopology.Quads`), and `m_SubmeshIndex`.

2. Empty Submesh Pruning and Material Compaction:
- `mesh.subMeshCount` is assigned `submeshes.Length`.
- `currentSubmeshIndex` starts at 0.
- For each submesh `i` from 0 to `mesh.subMeshCount - 1`:
  - If `submeshes[i].m_Indexes.Length == 0`, the submesh is empty. ProBuilder removes the corresponding material from `MaterialUtility.s_MaterialArray` at `currentSubmeshIndex`, sets `submeshes[i].submeshIndex = -1`, and decrements `face.submeshIndex` by 1 for all faces where `face.submeshIndex > currentSubmeshIndex`.
  - If `submeshes[i].m_Indexes.Length > 0`, `submeshes[i].submeshIndex` is assigned `currentSubmeshIndex`.

3. Degenerate Triangle Detection and Removal:
- For triangle topology (`MeshTopology.Triangles`), the algorithm iterates through triangle index triplets `tri` at step 3 (`indexes[tri]`, `indexes[tri+1]`, `indexes[tri+2]`):
  - Computes edge vectors: `ab = positions[indexes[tri + 1]] - positions[indexes[tri]]` and `ac = positions[indexes[tri + 2]] - positions[indexes[tri]]`.
  - Evaluates cross product magnitude: `if (Vector3.Cross(ab, ac).sqrMagnitude < Mathf.Epsilon)`, the triangle is degenerate. `numBadIndices` is incremented by 3.
  - Non-degenerate triangle indices are shifted left by `numBadIndices`: `indexes[tri - numBadIndices + k] = indexes[tri + k]` for `k in {0, 1, 2}`.
- If `numBadIndices > 0`, creates a compacted index array `fixedIndices` of length `indexes.Length - numBadIndices`.
- Calls `mesh.SetIndices(fixedIndices, submeshes[i].m_Topology, submeshes[i].submeshIndex, false)`.
- `currentSubmeshIndex` is incremented by 1.

4. Material Array Synchronization:
- If `mesh.subMeshCount < materialCount`, trailing unused materials are removed from `MaterialUtility.s_MaterialArray` via `RemoveRange`.
- If materials were modified, `renderer.sharedMaterials = MaterialUtility.s_MaterialArray.ToArray()` reassigns the updated material array to the `MeshRenderer`.

5. Face Material Assignment (`SetMaterial`):
- When `SetMaterial(IEnumerable<Face> faces, Material material)` is called, it searches `renderer.sharedMaterials` for `material`.
- If not found, it scans for an unused `submeshIndex` among `m_Faces` to replace.
- If all submesh indices are in use, it appends `material` to `renderer.sharedMaterials`.
- It sets `face.submeshIndex = index` on all target faces and calls `IncrementVersionIndex()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, ArrayMesh surfaces map directly to materials (one material per surface). Godot's SurfaceTool creates surfaces matching each unique material. Empty surfaces can be omitted, and Godot MeshInstance3D.set_surface_override_material() or ArrayMesh.surface_set_material() provides identical submesh-to-material binding.

sections.heading: REFRESH PIPELINE
sections.content:
The compilation pipeline converts the editable ProBuilderMesh data model into a hardware-ready `UnityEngine.Mesh`. The pipeline is split into two primary methods: `ToMesh()` (which establishes vertex buffers, index buffers, submesh topology, and material bindings) and `Refresh(RefreshMask)` (which updates vertex attributes on top of the existing topology).

1. `RefreshMask` Enum Bitfield:
- `RefreshMask.UV = 1 << 0`: Rebuilds UV channel 0 for Auto-UV faces and copies UV channels 2 and 3.
- `RefreshMask.Colors = 1 << 1`: Reapplies `m_Colors` to `mesh.colors`.
- `RefreshMask.Normals = 1 << 2`: Recomputes vertex normals based on face smoothing groups and assigns to `mesh.normals`.
- `RefreshMask.Tangents = 1 << 3`: Recomputes tangent vectors and assigns to `mesh.tangents`.
- `RefreshMask.Collisions = 1 << 4`: Updates `MeshCollider.sharedMesh` if a `MeshCollider` is present.
- `RefreshMask.Bounds = 1 << 5`: Calls `mesh.RecalculateBounds()`.
- `RefreshMask.All = 0xFF`: Executes all refresh operations.

2. Step-by-Step Execution in `Refresh(RefreshMask mask)`:
- Step 1 (`RefreshMask.UV`): Calls `RefreshUV(facesInternal)`. If `m_Textures0` is missing or desynchronized with `vertexCount`, initializes `m_Textures0 = new Vector2[vertexCount]`, sets `manualUV = false` on all faces, and processes all faces. For each face, if `face.manualUV` is false and `face.indexesInternal.Length >= 3`:
  - If `face.textureGroup` is 0 or invalid (`<= 0`), calls `UvUnwrapping.Unwrap(this, face)`.
  - If `face.textureGroup > 0` and `s_CachedHashSet.Add(textureGroup)` succeeds, calls `UvUnwrapping.ProjectTextureGroup(this, textureGroup, face.uv)` to project all faces in that group simultaneously.
  - Assigns `mesh.uv = m_Textures0`. If channels 2 or 3 exist, uploads them via `mesh.SetUVs(2, m_Textures2)` and `mesh.SetUVs(3, m_Textures3)`.
- Step 2 (`RefreshMask.Colors`): Calls `RefreshColors()`, which sets `filter.sharedMesh.colors = m_Colors`.
- Step 3 (`RefreshMask.Normals`): Calls `RefreshNormals()`, which executes `Normals.CalculateNormals(this)` (handling hard edges and smoothing groups) and sets `mesh.normals = m_Normals`.
- Step 4 (`RefreshMask.Tangents`): Calls `RefreshTangents()`, which executes `Normals.CalculateTangents(this)` using vertex normals and UV0 coordinates, then sets `mesh.tangents = m_Tangents`.
- Step 5 (`RefreshMask.Collisions`): Calls `EnsureMeshColliderIsAssigned()`. If `userCollisions` is false and a `MeshCollider` exists on the GameObject, assigns `collider.sharedMesh = mesh`.
- Step 6 (`RefreshMask.Bounds`): If `mesh != null`, invokes `mesh.RecalculateBounds()`.
- Step 7: Invokes `IncrementVersionIndex()`, incrementing `m_VersionIndex` and `m_InstanceVersionIndex`, and firing the `versionChanged` event.

3. Method Relationships:
- `Rebuild()`: Calls `ToMesh()` followed by `Refresh()`.
- `meshSyncState` (`MeshSyncState` enum: `Null`, `NeedsRebuild`, `Lightmap`, `InSync`): Evaluates whether `m_VersionIndex == m_InstanceVersionIndex` and checks whether lightmap UV2 is present.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, updating an ArrayMesh is performed by clearing surfaces and repopulating them using SurfaceTool or RenderingServer.multimesh/mesh API. Selective mask updates (normals, tangents, UVs, colors) can be applied using MeshDataTool or regenerating surface arrays without re-parsing topological face structures.

sections.heading: SELECTION STATE
sections.content:
ProBuilderMesh stores selection state directly within the component for faces, edges, and vertices, enabling integration with Unity's undo system and editor tooling. The selection state architecture is structured as follows:

1. Selection Storage Fields:
- `m_SelectedFaces` (`int[]`): Array of selected face indices in `m_Faces`.
- `m_SelectedEdges` (`Edge[]`): Array of selected `Edge` structs, each containing vertex index pair `.a` and `.b`.
- `m_SelectedVertices` (`int[]`): Array of selected vertex indices in `m_Positions`.
- `m_IsSelectable` (`bool`): Determines whether elements can be selected on this mesh instance.

2. Selection Query Properties and Methods:
- `selectedFaceCount`, `selectedEdgeCount`, `selectedVertexCount` return the lengths of `m_SelectedFaces`, `m_SelectedEdges`, and `m_SelectedVertices`.
- `GetSelectedFaces()` returns a newly allocated `Face[]` array resolved by mapping `m_SelectedFaces[i]` into `m_Faces`.
- `selectedFaceIndexes`, `selectedEdges`, `selectedVertices` expose read-only collections (`ReadOnlyCollection<int>`, `ReadOnlyCollection<Edge>`).
- `GetActiveFace()` returns the most recently selected face (`m_Faces[m_SelectedFaces[selectedFaceCount - 1]]`), or `null` if selection is empty.
- `GetActiveEdge()` returns the most recently selected edge (`m_SelectedEdges[selectedEdgeCount - 1]`), or `Edge.Empty` if empty.
- `GetActiveVertex()` returns the most recently selected vertex index (`m_SelectedVertices[selectedVertexCount - 1]`), or `-1` if empty.

3. Coincident and Shared Selection Caching (`CacheSelection()`):
- When `m_SelectedCacheDirty` is true, `CacheSelection()` recomputes `m_SelectedSharedVertices` (HashSet of unique shared vertex indices from `sharedVertexLookup`) and `m_SelectedCoincidentVertices` (List of all vertex indices coincident with the selection).
- `selectedSharedVerticesCount` returns `m_SelectedSharedVerticesCount`.
- `selectedCoincidentVertexCount` returns `m_SelectedCoincidentVertexCount`.
- `selectedSharedVertices` and `selectedCoincidentVertices` expose the cached enumerables.

4. Selection Setter Synchronization:
- `SetSelectedFaces(IEnumerable<int> selected)`: Sets `m_SelectedFaces`; updates `m_SelectedVertices` to all distinct vertex indices belonging to those faces (`facesInternal[x].distinctIndexesInternal`); updates `m_SelectedEdges` to all edges belonging to those faces (`facesInternal[x].edges`); sets `m_SelectedCacheDirty = true`; invokes `elementSelectionChanged?.Invoke(this)`.
- `SetSelectedEdges(IEnumerable<Edge> edges)`: Clears `m_SelectedFaces` to empty array; sets `m_SelectedEdges`; updates `m_SelectedVertices` to all vertex indices from those edges (`m_SelectedEdges.AllTriangles()`); sets `m_SelectedCacheDirty = true`; invokes `elementSelectionChanged?.Invoke(this)`.
- `SetSelectedVertices(IEnumerable<int> vertices)`: Clears `m_SelectedFaces` and `m_SelectedEdges` to empty arrays; sets `m_SelectedVertices` to distinct vertex indices; sets `m_SelectedCacheDirty = true`; invokes `elementSelectionChanged?.Invoke(this)`.
- `ClearSelection()`: Sets `m_SelectedFaces = new int[0]`, `m_SelectedEdges = new Edge[0]`, `m_SelectedVertices = new int[0]`, and sets `m_SelectedCacheDirty = true`.
- `AddToFaceSelection(int index)`: Appends face index and updates selection arrays.
- `RemoveFromFaceSelectionAtIndex(int index)`: Removes face at array index and updates selection arrays.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, editor plugins maintain selection state in an EditorPlugin or custom Gizmo/Tool context. Storing selection directly on the mesh node or resource allows undo/redo actions through Godot's UndoRedo class.

sections.heading: LIFECYCLE
sections.content:
ProBuilderMesh implements a rigorous lifecycle managing component initialization, duplication, destruction, undo/redo serialization, and prefab synchronization:

1. Factory Creation Methods:
- `ProBuilderMesh.Create()`: Instantiates a `GameObject`, adds `ProBuilderMesh`, sets `m_MeshFormatVersion = k_MeshFormatVersion`, calls `Clear()`, and returns the component.
- `ProBuilderMesh.Create(IEnumerable<Vector3> positions, IEnumerable<Face> faces)`: Instantiates a `GameObject`, adds component, and invokes `RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(positions, faces)`.
- `ProBuilderMesh.Create(IList<Vertex> vertices, IList<Face> faces, IList<SharedVertex> sharedVertices, IList<SharedVertex> sharedTextures, IList<Material> materials)`: Full-attribute factory. Sets `renderer.sharedMaterials`, calls `SetVertices(vertices)`, sets `faces`, `sharedVertices`, `sharedTextures`, and executes `ToMesh()` followed by `Refresh()`.
- `ProBuilderMesh.CreateInstanceWithPoints(Vector3[] positions)`: Quad-point builder. Verifies `positions.Length % 4 == 0`, generates two triangles per 4 points (`[i, i+1, i+2, i+1, i+3, i+2]`), sets shared vertices via `SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions`, and compiles the mesh.

2. Initialization (`Awake` and `Reset`):
- `Awake()`: Calls `EnsureMeshFilterIsAssigned()`, `EnsureMeshColliderIsAssigned()`, and `ClearSelection()`. If `vertexCount > 0 && faceCount > 0 && meshSyncState == MeshSyncState.Null`, enters a `NonVersionedEditScope(this)`, executes `Rebuild()`, and invokes `meshWasInitialized?.Invoke(this)`.
- `Reset()`: When component is reset, if `meshSyncState != MeshSyncState.Null`, executes `Rebuild()` and invokes `componentHasBeenReset?.Invoke(this)`.

3. Destruction (`OnDestroy` and `DestroyUnityMesh`):
- `OnDestroy()`: Resets `m_MeshFilter.hideFlags = HideFlags.None`. Invokes `componentWillBeDestroyed?.Invoke(this)`.
- If `!preserveMeshAssetOnDestroy && Application.isEditor && !Application.isPlaying && Time.frameCount > 0`, invokes `DestroyUnityMesh()`. (The `Time.frameCount > 0` guard prevents destroying shared scene meshes during editor scene loading).
- `DestroyUnityMesh()`: Invokes `meshWillBeDestroyed?.Invoke(this)` if subscribers exist; otherwise executes `DestroyImmediate(gameObject.GetComponent<MeshFilter>().sharedMesh, true)`.

4. Mesh Uniqueness and Duplication (`MakeUnique` and `CopyFrom`):
- `MakeUnique()`: When duplicating or instantiating a GameObject, the new component shares the reference to the original `UnityEngine.Mesh`. Calling `MakeUnique()` creates an independent copy via `Instantiate(mesh)` (or `new Mesh()`), assigns `name = $"pb_Mesh{this.GetObjectId()}"`, and if `meshSyncState == MeshSyncState.InSync`, sets `filter.mesh = mesh`; otherwise calls `ToMesh()` and `Refresh()`.
- `CopyFrom(ProBuilderMesh other)`: Deep copies `positions`, `sharedVertices`, `sharedTextures`, cloned `faces`, UV channels 0 through 3, `tangents`, `colors`, `userCollisions`, `selectable`, and `unwrapParameters`.

5. Undo Integration & Serialization Callbacks:
- All mesh topology arrays (`m_Positions`, `m_Faces`, `m_SharedVertices`, `m_SharedTextures`, `m_Colors`, `m_Textures0`, `m_Tangents`) and selection arrays (`m_SelectedFaces`, `m_SelectedEdges`, `m_SelectedVertices`) are `[SerializeField]`, allowing Unity's `Undo.RecordObject` to serialize and restore full mesh state.
- Implements `ISerializationCallbackReceiver`: `OnAfterDeserialize()` calls `InvalidateCaches()` to invalidate `m_SharedVertexLookup`, `m_SharedTextureLookup`, and face caches.
- `NonVersionedEditScope`: An `IDisposable` struct that captures `m_VersionIndex` on construction and restores `m_Mesh.m_VersionIndex` and `m_Mesh.m_InstanceVersionIndex` on `Dispose()`, preventing transient initialization edits from marking version indices dirty.

6. Driven Properties & Prefab Support:
- Under `ENABLE_DRIVEN_PROPERTIES`, `ApplyDrivenProperties()` registers `m_Mesh` on `ProBuilderMesh` and `MeshCollider` using `SerializationUtility.RegisterDrivenProperty` to prevent prefab instance modifications from recording spurious overrides.
- Modifying `mesh` property calls `EditorUtility.SetDirty(this)` and `PrefabUtility.RecordPrefabInstancePropertyModifications(this)`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, duplicating a Node does not automatically duplicate sub-resources (like ArrayMesh) unless duplicate(DUPLICATE_USE_INSTANTIATION) or duplicate(DUPLICATE_SCRIPTS) is customized. A MakeUnique method in Godot calls Resource.duplicate() on the internal mesh resource to detach from shared assets.
